LanguageData.INSDoor_Biomass.label: Insulated Autodoor (Biomass)
LanguageData.INSDoor_Biomass.description: A biomass-insulated door that divides rooms and has an insulation-value of 25%. Powered operation allows people to move through the door without slowing down.
LanguageData.INSDoorSimple_Biomass.label: Insulated Door (Biomass)
LanguageData.INSDoorSimple_Biomass.description: A biomass insulated door that divides rooms and has an insulation-value of 25%. Simple doors must be manually opened, which slows people down. The amount of slowdown depends on what the door is made of.
